title: fix(text): keep local validation a ValidationError instead of UpstreamError
author: SvirepyiBambr

gist.summary: Empty `messages` arrays in text requests now produce a `400 BAD_REQUEST` response with a `ValidationError` and a field error on `messages`. Previously, this local validation failure was wrapped as an `UpstreamError`, which could lead clients to treat it as a retryable provider fault. `prepareMessages()` now throws a `ValidationError`, and `throwTextError()` passes it through unchanged.
